audit.why: packet.suspectNames flagged 'Cosmic Radiance' and 'Magical Journey' as possible misspellings, but both are the real ability names (enemyKit.R and ownerKit.E) — false positives, no fix needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[5].side and phases[6].side both read Taric, but content win[5] and win[6] read Skill — and content whys[5]/whys[6] both explicitly argue it stays a skill check (roams/Q-pick threat offsetting his sustain-peel), not a Taric lead.
audit.why: phases[N].side and win[N] are the same row and must agree; content's reasoning for rows 5-6 is specific and kit-grounded, so the full-layer side (generic template text, no argument for Taric) is the stale one.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[5]/[6].side to Skill with matching rating and grounded why text drawn from the same reasoning as content whys[5]/[6].

audit.why: Spikes correctly flag level 2 (Bard's stun/Meeps beat Taric's not-yet-online sustain), level 6 (Cosmic Radiance's delayed team invuln hard-counters an all-in), first item (heal-shield wall vs continued pick threat), late (peel vs Q-pick on an immobile target).

edits.before: First item: the meeps chunk and the portals make your jungler ambidextrous.
edits.after: His first item heal-shield wall blunts poke, but roams keep it even.

edits.before: Late Bard edits fights: R the engage or the objective, Q the chokes, and tunnel the team to the answer.
edits.after: His peel out-sustains you late, but a clean Q pick on his immobile body still keeps this even.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Drop W (Health shrine) before he engages — it only heals once shielded, so pre-place it and buy anti-heal early.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: R-ing your own carry into a Cosmic Radiance window wastes the invulnerability — time it to his engage.

edits.before: - Taric Cosmic Radiance: matchup-defining — The delayed invulnerability erases your teamfight damage — burst before it lands or wait it out. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Magical Journey banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Taric Cosmic Radiance is 180/150/120s — the delayed invulnerability erases your teamfight damage, burst before it lands or wait it out. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Magical Journey banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
